mapper.select: select id, user_id, name, dir_id from note_notes where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'

SELECT id, user_id, NAME, dir_id, content, del_flag, tenant_id, create_dept, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time FROM note_notes WHERE del_flag = '0' AND user_id = #{userId} AND (NAME LIKE #{keyword} OR content LIKE #{keyword} ) ORDER BY update_time DESC
mapper.update: update note_notes set content_hash = #{contentHash}, update_time = update_time where id = #{id} and content_hash is null and del_flag = '0'
